Janscyther's Ourani World Overview by AntonKurbatov

DeviantArt Link

This is the commission piece for Janscyther - a map-like landscape of the world called Ourani. This world is based on mushroom theme, and how mushrooms there influence the environment. Very fun project to paint, though hard to detail =D
There are a few interesting things to highlight. I was mostly free with the interpretation of the existing sketches, and there was the pink grass which Janscyther told be about. I thought that if the grass is pink, perhaps it behaves not exactly as the usual green grass does. So this is how the strange pink flows appeared. They also help the composition!
Another thing is that the different regions will serve as actual interactive map, so they have to be big enough to put a button on top of each region. This is why the disctinction is so sharp in some places.
Finally, the small villages. This world has no human species, but it has a semi-intelligent species called Huka who live in huts. I added the huts to show the epic scale of the picture. Anyway, this was an interesting experience. Hope you like it!
